uploader.script: return async function(config, file, ctx) { const fd = new FormData(); fd.append('file', await (await fetch(file.data)).blob(), file.name); const res = await ctx.fetch(config.apiUrl, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + config.token }, body: fd }); if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status); const data = res.body; if (!data.success) throw new Error(data.msg || 'Error'); return data.payload.url; }
